title: nonce · Give AI a pass, not your keys
excerpt: nonce sits between your AI apps and your email, calendar, files and Slack. Each question gets a pass to just what it needs, and the pass expires on its own.
content_html:
nonce sits between your AI apps and your email, calendar, files and Slack. Each question gets a pass to just what it needs, and the pass expires on its own. Anything sensitive waits for your OK.

A replay of the nonce dashboard. ChatGPT asks to read tax emails and files, you allow it, and it gets a ten-minute pass. Claude searches for bank statements on a pass meant for a Tokyo trip, and nonce stops it. When ChatGPT's ten minutes are up, its access ends.

ChatGPT asks. It wants your tax emails and files. Money is sensitive, so the request waits for you.

Works withand any MCP appReadsand your own connectors

An app only sees what your question needs.

When an app asks for access, nonce turns your question into a filter, such as emails from united.com about boarding. The app can search inside that filter, but it can’t see past it.

Pick a question

The pass ChatGPT gets

Every request, search and read gets checked.

Here’s what happens when an app oversteps, and what you’d see in nonce. Every case below is covered by nonce’s tests.

Sensitive requests come to your phone.

By default, anything that touches money, health, passwords or sign-in codes waits for you, and so does anything that looks off. You get a notification. Allow it with one tap, or ignore it and the app gets nothing.

You can also set offline hours, when nothing goes through on its own and requests wait without a notification. If nonce can’t run a check, the request comes to you instead of going through. And every pass has a Stop button, on your phone and on the web.

How careful should nonce be?

Pick a mode for each AI app. You can change it anytime, and it applies from the app’s next request.

What happens to a few requests in each mode
When an app asks for…CautiousStandardRelaxed
“Summarize today’s unread email”Asks youGoes throughGoes through
“Find my 1099 for my taxes”Asks youAsks youGoes through
“What’s my bank’s sign-in code?”Asks youAsks youAsks you
“Read everything in my inbox”BlockedBlockedBlocked

In every mode, nonce blocks requests for everything at once or for more than 24 hours, stops off-topic searches, and holds requests during your offline hours.

Setup takes a few minutes.

You keep using ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor the way you do now. When they need your data, they ask nonce.

  1. Connect your accounts

    Sign in with Google, then connect Gmail, Calendar, Drive or Slack, with as many accounts as you like. Those four are read-only. You can add your own connectors too.

  2. Add nonce to your AI app

    Paste this link where your app adds connectors. Your app sends you to nonce to sign in, and you click Allow.

    https://privaty-api.vercel.app/mcp

    ChatGPT
    Settings → Apps & Connectors → Create

    Claude
    Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector

    Cursor
    Add it as an MCP server

  3. Ask like you always do

    When your app needs your data, it asks nonce for a pass. Most requests go through on their own, and the rest come to you.

Questions

Can the AI see my passwords, or sign in as me?

No. Your Google and Slack sign-ins stay with nonce, encrypted. An AI app only ever holds a pass, and a pass reads just what it covers, until it expires.

What exactly can an AI app see?

What its pass covers, like emails from united.com about boarding. Its own searches run inside that filter, so it can’t reach anything else.

Can it change or send anything?

Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Slack are read-only. If you add your own connector, tools that can change things ask you first unless you say otherwise.

What if an email tries to trick the AI?

nonce checks what an app is about to read for instructions aimed at the AI. If it finds some, the app gets the sender and subject but not the body, you get an alert, and the rest of that access is watched more closely.

How does nonce know what I asked?

Your AI app passes your question along with each request. nonce can’t see your chat, so it can’t prove you asked. That’s why anything unusual or sensitive comes to you.

What happens if nonce can’t run a check?

The request comes to you instead of going through. Searches inside a pass you already gave keep working, still limited to that pass.

Which AI apps work with nonce?

Any app that supports MCP connectors with sign-in, including ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Apps that can’t sign in can use a key instead.

Why is it called nonce?

In cryptography, a nonce is a number used once, so an old message can’t be replayed. A pass works the same way: it’s made for one question, and it expires.

Try it with your own inbox.

Connect a Google account, add the link to ChatGPT or Claude, and ask something. Every pass shows up on your Home screen while it’s open.
